patch:
--- a/WSCUTOFF.cpy
+++ b/WSCUTOFF.cpy
@@ -4 +4 @@
-           05  WS-CUTOFF-CAP         PIC 9(5) VALUE 6000.
+           05  WS-CUTOFF-CAP         PIC 9(5) VALUE 5000.
rationale: The authorized finding identifies the cutoff cap as stale: it is 6000, while the approved formula caps the cutoff at Rs 5000. Updating this constant makes the existing calculation use min(one percent of credit limit, Rs 5000).
intended_behavior: WS-ACTION is CONSENT only when the refund exceeds min(one percent of credit limit, Rs 5000); otherwise it is ADJUST, including at equality.
